decisions.why: division is explicitly Pressure Area Care and the named products (Protecta Luxe, Protecta 7) are Medstrom's pressure-relieving mattress range, with the remaining examples describing a mattress rental/dignity service around them
the one example, ECO Shower, is a bathing/hygiene aid, matching the bathing and toileting aids type
division name is Hospital Beds; examples (Medstrom Solo Luxe, Medstrom Solo+, Medstrom SoloMH) are named bed models
all three examples are named 'X Bed and Dolphin Therapy' (Aria Lateral Tilt Bed, Eleganza 5 Bed, Multicare ITU Bed), i.e. bed models with an integrated therapy mattress feature
three of four named products (Vela XL Extra-Wide Stretcher, AER Magna, Versatech 1100) are bariatric beds and stretchers; Aria Turn+ Therapy is a bed-based turning system in the same range
